messages:
sara: quick sync: weekend incident where multiple layers added roles and unioning gave org:admin. need a small, deterministic policy.
diego: repro: client -> edge -> ingress -> operator-sidecar -> service. mapper currently unions.
chen: proposal: deny-overrides for conflicting high-priv roles, otherwise weighted precedence by source trust.
sara: suggested weights: service=100, operator=80, ingress=50, edge=40, client=10. specificity (project id) tiebreaker.
ops-bot: note: ingress-proxy schema will need a small stamp_id field so we can trust sources.
chen: cap untrusted claim weight to 20 so clients can't escalate. also hard cap claims/request at 200.
diego: migration: shadow logging 2w, ff canary 5% then ramp if metrics ok. add mapping_decisions_total and conflict_denied_total.
sec-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/599 "claim-composition-stamp-hierarchy" and attached traces.
